style: Cautious first-time visitor. Follows the clearest visible invitation, reads unfamiliar terms, and backs away from account or personal-data prompts. Curiosity is practical, not goal-driven.
Skims first, then follows anything that looks like personal progress or a useful summary. Impatient when labels repeat; tries nearby alternatives after a dead end.
Careful reader who wants to understand where information goes. Opens explanations, notices save-state wording, and uses back when a screen loses context.
Skeptical and comparison-oriented. Looks for evidence behind summaries, explores alternate views, and changes direction when a label over-promises.
Unhurried first visit. Reads labels before acting, scans the whole page, and prefers explicit navigation and readable text over compact controls.
